extraction_notes: Characterisation tables S1-S5 and DFT figures were not extracted. SI Table S6 literature-comparison rows from other papers were excluded; only the two 'This work' rows were used where they provide exact performance values. SI Figure S11 is a CO/H2/N2 feed without CO2 and was excluded.
